title: Extend a telescoping lamp
instruction: Extend the lamp to its full height.
context: Everyday two-handed coordination: one hand steadies the base while the other pulls.
setup: A collapsed telescoping desk lamp stands on a dark workbench, 22 cm in front of the arm bases: a weighted plastic base (12 cm diameter, 1.5 cm thick, 0.5 kg) with an 8 cm plastic outer tube (2.2 cm diameter), and a metal inner stem (1.6 cm diameter) carrying a plastic shade (8 cm diameter), which slides up to 7 cm.
scoring: 0.25 at 2 cm of extension; 0.5 at 4 cm; 1.0 at 6 cm or more with the base within 1 cm of its starting height and tilted less than 15 degrees. Capped at 0.5 if the base lifts more than 3 cm at any point.
fidelity: Approximate: the stem's friction is modeled as damping, and the stem doesn't sag under gravity.
